promise: Re-shoot a product video from one storyboard in landscape, vertical and square formats.
audience: People and agents producing repeatable videos of real web interfaces.
trigger: Validate, record, compose or re-shoot a storyboard-driven app teaser.

modes.name: Prepare
modes.when: A filmed app needs a repeatable edit.
modes.output: A storyboard with validated beats, steps and aspect-specific framing.

modes.name: Build
modes.when: A storyboard and capture environment are ready.
modes.output: Captured takes, videos, posters and contact sheets.

modes.name: Review
modes.when: The footage needs quality or privacy inspection.
modes.output: Contact-sheet findings; optional model review is advisory.

examples.title: Fictional app re-shoot
examples.brief: A fictional demo app changes one button and one shot must be recorded again.
examples.before: A manually recorded film requires a complete re-edit.
examples.after: The storyboard changes the one beat and preserves the edit in three shapes.
examples.why: The retained native capture/composition pipeline is independently useful to callers without Sizzle.

boundaries: Deterministic validation and rendering do not require a model key; optional plan/explore/review capabilities can incur provider cost.
Browser/ffmpeg prerequisites are explicit and are not installed as an unrequested side effect.
No new film, live browser recording or paid provider call was performed in this local packaging baseline.

verification.name: Native functional baseline
verification.evidence: 45 deterministic/mocked tests (1 e2e skipped) and 2 fictional storyboard validation checks passed; no film or provider call.

verification.name: Source-specific acceptance
verification.expected: Check real configuration/schema/validation branches without remote execution.
verification.evidence: 45 deterministic/mocked tests (1 e2e skipped) and 2 fictional storyboard validation checks passed; no film or provider call.

verification.name: Live execution acceptance
verification.expected: Explicitly authorized real provider, invite or video task.
verification.evidence: No paid model call, real invitation, permission mutation, browser recording or film render was performed.

verification.name: Clean wheel installation
verification.command: Build wheel, install into a fresh venv, then run installed entry points outside checkout
verification.expected: Stable native interfaces and packaged assets survive installation.
verification.evidence: All three wheels installed in a fresh Python 3.12 environment. Team Access help and TeaserKit no-AI storyboard validation passed; Imagen installed stdio smoke is recorded separately.

sources.role: Retained native owner implementation, import/CLI interfaces and complete source history.

consolidation: Public family repository name changes independently from stable native package/CLI/import identity.
No forced portable coaching wrapper; ordinary execution stays directly installable.
publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.
